title: SEAS: Self-Evolving Adversarial Safety Optimization for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's propensity to generate language or actions that unfairly treat certain groups by using automated adversarial red team prompts and measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) via a safety classifier.
Generating adversarial prompts categorized as 'One Sided Statement' to test if the model can be provoked into presenting biased or misleading viewpoints within a conversation.
